description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Collapse

You focus your Ratio on your opponent’s weapon. When you are targeted by a weapon attack, you can spend 5 CE as a reaction to create and hit a vulnerable ratio point on their weapon, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the weapon breaks. If the weapon is a cursed tool, you must use a tool of equal or greater rank to break it, otherwise the attack fails. If used against an unarmed strike, it is treated as a limb damaging effect using the Limb Damage table. Roll critical damage with your weapon. If you deal the required damage, you break the limb. Either way, the target takes no damage and this feature cannot remove a limb.
